blocks.textSample: Custom Fields Move upMove Custom Fields box upMove downMove Custom Fields box downToggle panel: Custom Fields Name Value Key Value194 Key Value6 Key ValueA hotel booking engine is a software application integrated into a hotel's website or mobile app that allows guests to check room availability, select their preferred room type, and complete a reservation with secure online payment — all in real time. Key ValueWhat is a hotel booking engine? Key ValueA booking engine increases direct bookings by providing a seamless, branded reservation experience on the hotel's own website. Features like exclusive promo codes, mobile-optimized checkout, rate comparison widgets, and integration with digital marketing campaigns encourage guests to book directly rather than through other indirect channels. Key ValueHow does a hotel booking engine increase direct bookings? Key ValueKey features include real-time inventory management, channel manager integration, secure payment processing (PCI DSS compliant), mobile responsiveness, multi-language and multi-currency support, reporting and analytics, and 24/7 vendor support.
